raw_production_diagnosis: Read-only diagnosis complete (no edits/build/tests). Route: changed production behavior, so keep the supplied actual-process RED and require minimal GREEN. `Program.cs:503` registers `IDbContextFactory<VulgataDbContext>` using Npgsql `EnableRetryOnFailure(3)`; selected startup invokes binder at `Program.cs:120`. `OctoberLocalAuthority.CaptureCurrentContextAsync` begins `IsolationLevel.Serializable` user transaction at line 597, then performs EF management queries within it and commits at 701. Actual `execution.log` shows successful Identity/auth and October metadata SQL, followed by EF query `NpgsqlRetryingExecutionStrategy` rejecting that manually opened transaction; Program exits `selected-data startup failed: Unavailable` before HTTP readiness. Proposed one-file production fix: in `CaptureCurrentContextAsync`, create `management.Database.CreateExecutionStrategy()` and execute the entire existing serializable transaction, all management reads/context projection, and commit inside its `ExecuteAsync` delegate, propagating the existing cancellation token and returning the same nullable snapshot. This keeps serializable coherent capture and ordinary Npgsql retries; no registration/configuration/public contract changes. Assess callers `AuthorizeSelectionAsync` and `IssueSourceApprovalAsync` because both use this method. Focused post-write command when root authorizes: `pwsh -NoProfile -File eng/test.ps1 -Suite E2E -WithPostgreSql -Filter 'FullyQualifiedName~SelectedWebProcess_RestartFromOwnedTargetAtoB_BindsEachBatchWithoutBrowserAuthority'`, then surrounding authority/host suites per task. The prior SourceStorage root harness issue is separate. No consequential design decision appears necessary.
